svg.aria-label: Data engineering pipeline. Ingestion: change data capture from Postgres and MySQL with Debezium into Kafka. Processing: stream and batch jobs in PySpark, Python and Pandas. Warehouse: Snowflake with staging, intermediate and mart layers. Modeling: dbt sources, models, tests and docs. Orchestration: Airflow DAGs with retries and backfills.
